window_policy: Nonoverlapping calendar blocks [year,year+5); partial edges marked. Indicators and holdings carry across blocks. No refit/search or per-block liquidation.
benchmark: CRSP total market Mkt-RF + RF, constructed total-return index; no directly executable price, spreads, individual-stock survivorship or intraday fills.
timing: signal close s, execution close s+1, first held interval s+1 to s+2
inference: HAC lag 5 and stationary bootstrap mean block 5/500 repetitions/seed17 prespecified. Return-score diagnostic, not MSE forecasting evidence. Exposed history and repeated inspection invalidate fresh-alpha interpretation.

unsupported.three_session: Needs timezone/DST-aware intraday FX bars and explicit rules; session taxonomy is not a unique entry/exit algorithm.
unsupported.orb: Needs opening-range OHLCV and exchange calendar; daily index cannot test it.
unsupported.breakout_retest: Needs explicit retest/confirmation/fill rules and intraday OHLCV.
unsupported.gap_earnings_news: Needs point-in-time publication/catalyst times, premarket/open prices, universe incl. delisted symbols and spreads.
unsupported.ml_ensemble: Existing learner remains underperforming; frozen ensemble and independent adoption period required.
unsupported.statistical_arbitrage: Existing pairs experiment retained separately; requires executable paired instruments and borrow history for trading claims.
